critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–72 ms, LCP 308–1288 ms, TTFB 1.5–7.5 ms, load 129–154 ms, zero long-frame ratio, no browser/request failures, and no horizontal overflow. Layout stability is excellent on mobile (CLS 0) and desktop (0.0011), though tablet CLS reaches 0.0478. The main weakness is transfer cost: 1.31 MB total with 1.15 MB of JavaScript for 17 requests; desktop animation also averages 19.3 ms per frame with a 33.4 ms worst frame.
critique.fix: Reduce the JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting and dead-code removal, then reserve dimensions for tablet-shifting content to lower CLS. Profile desktop rendering work to keep typical frames within the 16.7 ms budget.
